purpose: Judge the same lag-1 mechanism across independently frozen future Lightning and XXXtreme streams without using interim candidate performance.
hypothesis: The next winning number repeats the immediately previous winning number more often than the uniform 1/37 null.

lightning.economicPass: observed hit rate > 1/30 AND Wilson 95% lower bound > 1/30

xxxtreme.economicPass: observed hit rate > 1/20 AND Wilson 95% lower bound > 1/20

jointClaims.mechanismReplicationRequires: lag-1 passes its pre-existing multiplicity-corrected statistical gate independently in BOTH tables
jointClaims.lightningEconomicCandidateRequires: mechanismReplication plus Lightning's pre-existing statistical-and-economic promotionCandidate gate
jointClaims.dualTableEconomicCandidateRequires: mechanismReplication plus each table independently clears its own base payout break-even and Wilson lower-bound gate
